Battle of Kanayama Castle
Victory Conditions
  1. Make Ouchi Yoshitaka retreat
Defeat Conditions
  1. Mouri Motonari retreats
  2. Mouri HQ is captured

      retreats

Kumagai Nobunao and Kikkawa
Mototsune led the vanguard to
Mitsukazu's Kanayama Castle.
But on the way, they ran into
Ouchi Yoshitaka's ambush
and were surrounded.
